page: Google Cloud Platform t2d-standard-8 is a general-purpose server instance belonging to the t2d server family. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU operates with one thread per core and includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or a GPU.

Benchmark data shows strong single-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2688.09, placing it in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance is average, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 21511.57. Memory bandwidth tests yield average results, showing 996.35 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 95.12 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Other average-tier benchmarks include a Geekbench single-core score of 1455.0 and a multi-core score of 7817.0.

The instance is configured for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources without hyperthreading, offering a balanced resource density of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. It is applicable for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations, as reflected by its average score of 6859.59 in Passmark database operations and 14.93 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration limits its utility for large-scale storage-heavy tasks or deep learning training.
